result.summary: The page appears visually intact with no critical or major broken elements. There is one minor styling inconsistency regarding a promotional badge.

issues.description: The bottom-most visible restaurant card has a badge displaying '-0%', which is logically redundant and visually confusing as it implies a discount where none exists.
issues.suggestion: Remove the '-0%' badge entirely or replace it with a meaningful promotional label if a campaign is active.
